title: Hobbies
text:
I love playing guitar because it allows me to express emotions through music. I’ve been practicing for 5 years and can play both acoustic and electric guitar. What’s more, I enjoy covering pop songs and writing original riffs.




Running helps me clear my mind and stay fit. I run 3–4 times a week, and last year I completed my first 10k race!



Gaming is my way to relax and connect with friends online. My favorite genres are RPGs and strategy games. I’m currently playing Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom.
